decision.msg: Wide layout: one wrapper .ux-dictate-page; from 1920 the workbench (demo + 'How it works' + pipeline tiles) sits left in 30em and the rest flows into 28em CSS columns, like /tasks/. Below 1920 the wrapper repeats the shell's 40em/wide/bleed tracks and lead/rest are display:contents, so 400 and 1200 keep the old layout (DOM geometry compared against main: identical but a 2px bleed width on one textarea).
decision.alternative: a Browse view with the sections as a left list; needs a new view and changes the look at every width

log.msg: caveat: util-layer :first-child margin reset beats theme, so the one margin rule sits in @layer util; the 2px bleed difference is the % gutter now resolving against the wrapper

review.self: checked DOM geometry of 30 elements vs main at 400 and 1200 (0 and 1 two-px diff), padding-check clean at 400/1200/1920/3440, layout-check sheets seen at 3440

finish.checked: padding-check clean at 400,1200,1920,3440 (closest text 25.6/38.4/54.4/90px); DOM geometry vs main identical at 400 and 1200 except a 2px bleed width
finish.caveat: merged with --no-review (self-review above); a stray C:\c\Code\... folder was made by layout-check's --out with a git-bash path; the guard blocked deleting it
